en: The app has one name everywhere: the permission questions no longer name it (the system already shows its name above them), and its iCloud folder is called Montana, as under the icon.
ru: У приложения одно имя везде: вопросы о разрешениях больше не называют его (система и так пишет имя над ними), а папка в iCloud называется Montana, как под иконкой.
zh-Hans: 应用在各处只有一个名字：权限提示不再写出应用名（系统已在提示上方显示它），其 iCloud 文件夹名为 Montana，与图标下的名字一致。

en: No new server, network road or key leaving the device. Each product's name is stated once (Code/Names.xcconfig: MT_NAME_PROTOCOL, MT_NAME_MESSENGER); the iCloud folder reads it, no purpose string names an app, and tools/mt-names-check.py (rules 8 and 9) holds the store page and the site to the same owner.
